meta.task: I want to listen to music

defs.name: Music Player: Now Playing Stage
defs.genInstructions: Build a large hero panel showing the current track's album art, title, artist, album, year, and a live animated frequency-bar/waveform visualizer plus a scrolling lyrics or liner-notes area. It is the visual focal point that tells the user exactly what is playing right now.
defs.role: The central display surface that renders the currently playing track's identity and live audio visuals for the whole player.

effectors.name: Music Player: Queue Side Panel
effectors.description: When the queue's current item changes — via user double-clicking a queue row, drag-reordering that moves a new item to the top of Up Next, or an auto-advance — the queue emits the full track object (art URL, title, artist, album, duration, year, lyrics) and this stage swaps its artwork, metadata text, and lyrics pane to that track with a crossfade.

effectors.name: Music Player: Transport Control Bar
effectors.description: The transport emits playback state (playing/paused) and the live elapsed-time tick; the stage starts/freezes its visualizer animation accordingly and scrolls the lyrics line matching the current timestamp.

effectors.name: Music Player: Equalizer And Output Panel
effectors.description: When any EQ band gain, preset, or output device changes, the panel emits the new band-gain array; the stage's visualizer re-weights its rendered frequency bars to reflect the shaped spectrum.

defs.name: Music Player: Transport Control Bar
defs.genInstructions: Build a full-width bottom bar with play/pause, previous, next, shuffle, repeat, a draggable seek bar with elapsed/remaining timestamps, and a volume slider with mute. It is the primary playback control surface for the whole player.
defs.role: The command center for playback, driving playback state and position for the now playing stage and advancing the queue.

effectors.name: Music Player: Queue Side Panel
effectors.description: The queue emits the active track's duration and whether previous/next items exist; the bar rescales its seek track to that duration and enables or disables the prev/next buttons accordingly.

targets.name: Music Player: Now Playing Stage
targets.description: Emits playback state (playing/paused) plus a continuous elapsed-time tick and seek-jump events; the stage animates or freezes its visualizer and syncs the scrolling lyrics line to the emitted timestamp.

targets.name: Music Player: Queue Side Panel
targets.description: Pressing next/previous, or a track ending, emits an advance/rewind command; the queue moves its current-item pointer (respecting shuffle and repeat-one/repeat-all modes emitted by the toggles) and highlights the new active row.

defs.name: Music Player: Library Browser Grid
defs.genInstructions: Build a scrollable grid/table of albums and tracks with cover thumbnails, title, artist, album, duration, a search field, and sort plus genre filter controls, with hover 'Play Now' and 'Add to Queue' actions. It is how the user finds and starts music.
defs.role: The discovery surface where the user searches and browses the catalog and pushes chosen tracks into the playback queue.

effectors.name: Music Player: Playlist Navigation Rail
effectors.description: Selecting a playlist, genre, or smart collection in the rail emits its collection id; the grid re-queries and renders only the tracks belonging to that collection and updates its header title and track count.

targets.name: Music Player: Queue Side Panel
targets.description: Clicking 'Play Now' on a row emits that track (and its sibling album/collection tracks) to replace the queue and set it as the current item; clicking 'Add to Queue' emits a single track object that is appended to the end of the queue list.

defs.name: Music Player: Queue Side Panel
defs.genInstructions: Build a side panel listing the current track and the Up Next order with drag-and-drop reordering, per-row remove buttons, a clear-all action, and total remaining time. It holds and manages playback order for the session.
defs.role: The authoritative playback order for the session, receiving tracks from the library and feeding the current track to the stage and transport.

effectors.name: Music Player: Library Browser Grid
effectors.description: Receives 'Play Now' payloads that replace the entire queue and set the current item, and 'Add to Queue' payloads that append a track to the end of the Up Next list with a brief insert highlight.

effectors.name: Music Player: Transport Control Bar
effectors.description: Receives next/previous/auto-advance commands plus current shuffle and repeat mode; moves the current-item pointer accordingly (random pick when shuffled, wrap or hold on repeat) and scrolls the new active row into view.

targets.name: Music Player: Now Playing Stage
targets.description: Whenever the current item changes (double-click on a row, reorder, removal of the active track, or auto-advance) emits the full track object — artwork, title, artist, album, year, lyrics — which the stage renders.

targets.name: Music Player: Transport Control Bar
targets.description: Emits the active track's duration and flags for whether previous/next items exist so the transport can rescale its seek bar and enable or disable the skip buttons.

defs.name: Music Player: Playlist Navigation Rail
defs.genInstructions: Build a narrow left rail listing library sections (All Songs, Albums, Artists, Recently Played, Favorites) and the user's playlists with icons, counts, and a new-playlist action. It scopes what the library browser shows.
defs.role: The navigation spine that scopes the library browser to a chosen collection or playlist.

targets.name: Music Player: Library Browser Grid
targets.description: On selecting a section or playlist, emits the collection id and type; the grid clears its search box, re-queries that collection's tracks, and updates its header title and count to match.

defs.name: Music Player: Equalizer And Output Panel
defs.genInstructions: Build a compact panel with a multi-band EQ slider stack, preset selector (Flat, Rock, Bass Boost, Vocal), a bass/treble quick pair, and an output device selector with crossfade duration. It lets the user shape how the music sounds.
defs.role: The sound-shaping utility that tunes audio output and informs the now playing visualizer of the resulting spectrum.

targets.name: Music Player: Now Playing Stage
targets.description: On any band slider drag, preset selection, or output device change, emits the current band-gain array; the stage's frequency visualizer re-weights and redraws its bars to reflect the shaped output spectrum.
